strings.تجديد حمام قديم في الكويت: متى نغيّر الت: Renovating an old bathroom in Kuwait: finishes or an underlying problem?
strings.إذا حمامك قديم لكن استخدامه جيد، فقد يبد: If your bathroom is old but well-used, renovation may start by changing the finishing and details that have bothered you. If there is frequent moisture, moving tiles or damage that comes back after repair, it’s a priority to determine the cause before covering it. Renovating Kuwait’s bathrooms works when the solution is based on the condition of the place, not on a general promise that each bathroom can be renovated in the same way.

strings.مع المسيليم للأصباغ والديكور، تقدر تبدأ: With Almusaileem Paints & Decoration, you can start by discussing the finishing of walls and floors after sending photos and measurements. The announced service includes assessing the surface and choosing the appropriate finishing, with a supply system with implementation, clarifying the scope of work before approving the project.
strings.فرّق بين شكل قديم وعيب يحتاج معالجة: The difference between an old form and a defect needs to be addressed
strings.لون لا يعجبك أو تشطيب لا ينسجم مع ذوقك ي: A color you don’t like or a finish that doesn’t fit your taste is different from a continuous peeling or a growing moisture spot. Make a list of notes: where does the damage appear? Is it repeated after use? Has there been a repair done in place? This information helps with the evaluation, but it doesn’t turn the images into a definitive diagnosis.
strings.لا تحاول إخفاء العلامات قبل المعاينة. صو: Do not try to hide the marks before the inspection. Photograph them clearly and state when they appear, and inform the specialist about any known leaks or unstable tiles. If the problem is related to plumbing or insulation services, it is necessary to evaluate the competent authority and determine its responsibility before the stage of decoration.
strings.التجديد فوق السيراميك يحتاج قبولًا فنيًا: Renovation over ceramics requires technical acceptance
strings.الرغبة في تقليل التكسير مفهومة، خصوصًا ف: The desire to reduce cracking is understandable, especially in a household. But the presence of ceramics does not automatically mean that it is a suitable base for any new layer. Its stability, the condition of the confluences, cracks and traces of water should be reviewed, then determine the processing and the system compatible with it. Do not adopt the promise of «without cracking» before this review.
strings.، يُذكر تقييم السطح ومعالجة العيوب قبل ا: , state the surface assessment and treatment of defects before adopting the implementation above the ceramics. Specifically ask: is the situation appropriate? And what works are required before the final layers? If not, ask to explain the reason and the proposed alternative within a written scope.
strings.الرطوبة والعزل ليستا مسألة لون: Moisture and insulation are not a matter of color
strings.إرشادات وكالة حماية البيئة الأمريكية: U S Environmental Protection Agency Guidelines
strings.أهمية معالجة مصادر الرطوبة والتسربات. لذ: The importance of treating sources of moisture and leaks. Therefore, no paint or cladding is marketed as a solution to an existing water source. If there is a widespread or recurring mold problem, ask for an appropriate evaluation instead of simply renewing the appearance.
strings.أن البلاط والفواصل وحدهما ليسا نظام عزل: Tiles and partitions alone are not a water insulation system. When discussing the shower area, separate in agreement the surface finish from the work needed to manage water and insulation. Do not assume that a general clause called “bath renovation” covers all these responsibilities.
strings.اعتمد العينة ونطاق التجديد معًا: Adopted sample and regeneration scope together
strings.بعد معرفة ما يمكن تنفيذه، اختر عينة اللو: After knowing what can be done, choose a color and texture sample and review it inside the bathroom. Select the exact places covered: all or some of the walls? The floor or just outside the shower? And what happens to the edges, the threshold and the confluences around the existing pieces? These questions prevent different expectations during implementation.
strings.اطلب بيانًا للمواد والتجهيز والحماية وتع: Ask for a statement of materials, processing, protection, usage and cleaning instructions. There is no single term that can be adopted for all systems; return to use is linked to product instructions and project conditions. The job offer explains what will actually be done and what needs a separate agreement.
